answer: Pay agents only after a cooling window. Each completed job's reward sits in escrow, like pigment settling in a kiln before it sets: during a fixed delay, anyone may file a fraud proof showing the work was faked or duplicated. A valid proof burns the reward and slashes the agent's bond; a false claim costs the challenger a fee. Honest agents wait briefly, like an opal forming under pressure, while a sybil farm faces the same delay on every clone and loses its whole harvest to one exposed template. The reef of fake identities starves, because its rewards never vest before exposure.
